cards.title: My son is leaving home for university
cards.body: A parent grapples with empty nest syndrome as their first-born heads off to university with new saucepans in tow. The emotional reality of this life transition hits harder than expected, challenging the notion that 'empty nesting' is simply nature taking its course.

cards.title: I forgot so much about baby care
cards.body: A second-time parent discovers they've forgotten fundamental aspects of infant care—from feeding to teething to nappies. With help from grandparents, memories of their own relaxed childhood resurface amid the chaos of starting over.

cards.title: Should AI replace parenting decisions?
cards.body: Tech companies now offer eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts, and optimized nap predictions for parents. But do families actually need these AI-driven parenting tools, or do they add unnecessary complexity?

cards.title: Rethinking the '18 summers' parenting trend
cards.body: Modern parenting trends push 'making memories' during school holidays, turning unstructured time into controlled exercises. But maybe long, boring days with nothing to do is exactly what children need.

cards.title: Parenting considerations for gifted children
cards.body: Advanced learners face unique challenges in school that require specialized parenting approaches. Understanding these differences helps parents support their gifted children effectively.

cards.title: Living with parents as a young adult
cards.body: Young adults living with their parents gain unexpected benefits beyond financial savings. This arrangement can strengthen family bonds and reshape adult child-parent relationships positively.

cards.title: Is America obsessed with mother failure?
cards.body: Motherhood has become a cultural spectacle where women face impossible standards and intense scrutiny. It's time to disengage from the unrealistic expectation that mothers must do everything perfectly.

cards.title: Postpartum psychosis in the spotlight
cards.body: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency involving mania, depression, hallucinations, and delusions. Recent legal cases are bringing increased awareness to this serious maternal health condition.

cards.title: Cycling parents shouldn't fear children's safety
cards.body: Parents should not be scared their children won't return from cycling races, despite tragic incidents. Athletes emphasize that competitive cycling remains a safe pursuit for young participants.
